votes.motion: A procedural motion was made by Brooke D'Sousa, seconded by Marci Houseman to approve the substitution of the draft alternate Resolution #22-43C as presented this evening with an amendment in language as discussed by the Council, which would be discussed and voted upon at the public hearing scheduled for the September 20, 2022 City Council Meeting
A motion was made by Cyndi Sharkey, seconded by Marci Houseman, to approve the Consent Calendar
